headline: 5 Michigan deals, $128M raised — led by Cinnaire Fund for Housing Limited Partnership 44

top_deals.company: Cinnaire Fund for Housing Limited Partnership 44
top_deals.summary: Cinnaire Fund for Housing Limited Partnership 44, a Lansing-based private equity fund, disclosed a $185M raise; $90.1M sold to 10 investors.
HealthBridge Financial, Inc., a Grand Rapids-based health care company, filed a $20M debt offering under Rule 506(b); $20M sold to 7 investors.
HealthBridge Financial, Inc., a Grand Rapids-based health care company, filed a $18.6M debt and options/warrants offering under Rule 506(b); $17.9M sold to 15 investors. (Amended filing.)
High Street Holdco, LLC, a Traverse City-based company, filed a Form D tied to a business combination (acquisition or merger); $8.6M of equity and options/warrants issued to 2 investors.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $128M sold across 3 Form D filings this week, down 31% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was HealthBridge Financial, Inc. (Grand Rapids, Other Health Care) targeting $20M. Good question to ask: are founders in health care & life sciences favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
High Street Holdco, LLC disclosed a deal. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan financial services assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

1 Michigan-based pooled fund filed Form Ds, reporting $90.1M raised so far — led by Cinnaire Fund for Housing Limited Partnership 44 (Private Equity Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
